'''Epsilon 34G''' was an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] on [[Centerpoint Station]]. During the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Sadras Koyan]] received an incoming [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] transmission from [[Denjax Teppler]], the [[Five Worlds]]' [[Minister of Information (Five Worlds)|Minister of Information]], warning him to leave the station before the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] could bring him to a war trial. Teppler directed him to the airlock, and told him that a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] would be waiting to bring Koyan to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="LotF: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

In actuality, Teppler was trying to get rid of Koyan. Upon reaching the airlock Koyan boarded the shuttle that was waiting there, but it turned out to be the Galactic Alliance shuttle ''[[Chinnith]]''.<ref name="LotF: Fury" />
